$comment: 语法大厅 G17（V0.9 P2a 骨架层）。比喻锚点：力度记号（f/p/mf），表达强弱与态度——must 最重，should 恳切，can 放行，may 轻声。暗线侧写：情态动词是古英语 preterite-present 动词的幸存者，三单从不加 s。八课亲戚 L2（助动词家族的搬家特权），L2 零改动。全部内容原创。
title: 情态动词一 can / may / must / should
metaphor: 力度记号（f/p/mf），表达强弱与态度
ketNote: can/must/should 在 KET Part 5、听力和口语里高频出没；mustn't（禁止）是听力告示题的常客。八课里的亲戚是 L2 的助动词家族。

sections.essence: 情态动词是话语的力度记号：must 最重，should 恳切，can 放行，may 轻声。
sections.why: 乐谱上同一个音符，标上 f 要奏得响亮，标上 p 要奏得轻柔——音没变，态度变了。英语说话也有这样的记号：动词本身不动，前面加一个小词，整句话的强弱和态度就定了。You must practise 是命令，没商量；You should practise 是恳切的建议；You can practise 是放行许可；May I practise? 是轻声的请求。中文其实也这么干——「必须、应该、可以、能」同样站在动词前面，这一点中英难得一致。但英语的情态动词是一支有特权的小分队：后面永远跟原形、自己从不加 s、提问时自己搬到主语前面，不请 do 帮忙。中国孩子的错几乎全出在特权上：he cans、must to go、Do you can——记号本身没选错，是把它当普通动词用了。
sections.metaphorStory: 银帆乐团的新乐谱发下来，小提琴手小凡发现每段开头都有小小的字母：f、mf、p。老师解释：「这是力度记号——f 是强，奏得斩钉截铁；mf 中强，认真而恳切；p 是弱，轻得像耳语。音符是同一批，记号一换，整段的性格就换了。」排练时老师的话也带着记号。她敲敲谱架说：You must watch my hands.——这是 f，命令，全团立刻抬头。她对小凡说：You should practise this bar tonight.——这是 mf，建议，语气恳切但不逼人。休息时她挥挥手：You can get some water.——放行。小凡想开窗，轻声问：May I open the window?——这是 p，礼貌得像羽毛落地。老师笑了：「记住，这四个小词就是说话的力度记号。它们还是团里资格最老的小分队：后面永远站动词原形，自己从不加 s，提问时不请 do 帮忙——自己走到句子最前面。」

cards.rule: 力度记号站在动词前，动词永远原形
cards.detail: can/may/must/should 后面直接接动词原形——没有 to，没有 -s，没有 -ed。
cards.example: She can swim. / You must wear a helmet.

cards.detail: 表能力（会）和许可（可以）。否定 can't（cannot 连写）。
cards.example: I can ride a bike. / You can go now. / Can I use your pen?

cards.detail: 更礼貌的请求许可，也表「也许」的猜测。
cards.example: May I come in? / It may rain later.（也许会下雨）

cards.detail: 必须、非做不可。⚠️ mustn't 表「禁止」，不是「不必」——「不必」要说 don't have to。
cards.example: You must stop at the red light. / You mustn't feed the animals.（禁止投喂）

cards.detail: 应该、最好这样做；否定 shouldn't（不该）。给朋友提建议、口语题答「怎么办」全靠它。
cards.example: You should drink more water. / You shouldn't stay up late.

cards.detail: ① 从不加 s（he can，绝不 he cans）；② 否定直接 + not（can't/mustn't/shouldn't）；③ 提问自己搬到主语前，不请 do。
cards.example: Can you hear me?（不说 Do you can hear me）

basic.en: You can sit here — this seat is free.
basic.cn: 你可以坐这儿，这个座位空着。（放行）
我可以借你的橡皮吗？（轻声请求）

basic.en: You must finish your homework first.
basic.cn: 你必须先写完作业。（最重的记号）

basic.en: You should go to bed early tonight.
basic.cn: 你今晚应该早点睡。（恳切建议）

mid.en: My little sister can't reach the top shelf.
mid.cn: 我妹妹够不到最上层的架子。（can 的否定）
参观者不得触摸画作。（禁止）

mid.en: It may snow tonight, so take your gloves.
mid.cn: 今晚也许下雪，带上手套。（may＝也许）

mid.en: You shouldn't eat so many sweets before dinner.
mid.cn: 晚饭前你不该吃这么多糖。

mid.en: Can you help me carry this music stand?
mid.cn: 你能帮我搬这个谱架吗？（can 举手提问）

trap.en: He can swim across the pool.
trap.note: can 后面是原形 swim——he 是三单也不加 s，特权在 can 身上。

trap.en: You must be quiet in the library.
trap.cn: 在图书馆里必须保持安静。
trap.note: must 直接接原形 be——不是 must to be，情态词不带 to。

trap.en: — Must I wash the dishes now? — No, you don't have to.
trap.note: 回答「不必」用 don't have to；说 you mustn't 就成了「禁止你洗」。
may 自己搬到主语前提问——不请 do，也不说 Do I may。

trap.en: She could already read at four.
trap.note: 说过去的能力，can 要换成过去形 could——情态词也有自己的过去式。

trap.en: You mustn't run by the pool!
trap.note: mustn't＝禁止，语气最重——跟「不必」是两回事。

redBlack.bad: — Must I pay for the ticket? — No, you mustn't.（想说：不必付钱）
redBlack.good: — Must I pay for the ticket? — No, you don't have to.
redBlack.why: mustn't 是「禁止付钱」——把「不必」说成「不准」，意思整个反了。

redBlack.bad: I sit here?（想问能不能坐）
redBlack.good: May I sit here? / Can I sit here?
redBlack.why: 没有情态记号，请求发不出去——听着像在宣布「我坐这儿了」。

redBlack.bad: He cans play chess very well.
redBlack.good: He can play chess very well.
redBlack.why: 情态动词从不加 s——特权就是「永不变形」。

redBlack.bad: She can sings very high notes.
redBlack.good: She can sing very high notes.
redBlack.why: can 后面站原形——s 一个也不许带。

redBlack.bad: You must to hand in your paper today.
redBlack.good: You must hand in your paper today.
redBlack.why: 情态词直接接原形，不带 to——它不是 want to 那一家的。

redBlack.bad: Do you can ride a horse?
redBlack.why: can 自己会搬家提问——再请 do 就是两个指挥抢拍子。

redBlack.bad: He should goes to see a dentist.
redBlack.good: He should go to see a dentist.
redBlack.why: should 后面也是原形——goes 的 s 多余。

redBlack.bad: — Can you skate? — Yes, I do.
redBlack.good: — Can you skate? — Yes, I can.
redBlack.why: 谁提问谁接简答——Can 问的，用 can 答。

redBlack.bad: You don't should eat in class.
redBlack.why: 情态词的否定直接加 not——不请 don't 帮忙。

redBlack.bad: I can swim when I was five.（想说五岁就会）
redBlack.good: I could swim when I was five.
redBlack.why: 过去的能力用 can 的过去形 could——情态词也要跟着故事的调走。

redBlack.bad: Can I go to the toilet?（有人说必须用 May）
redBlack.good: Can I...? / May I...? 都行。
redBlack.why: May I 更客气，Can I 口语完全通用——KET 不设这个坑。

redBlack.bad: He must be tired after the long trip.（这也是 must？）
redBlack.good: 对——这是 must 的「一定是」猜测用法。
redBlack.why: must 还能表有把握的推测（他一定累了）——KET 很少考，认识即可。

contrast.cn: 我会游泳。／你必须去。（小词站在动词前）
contrast.en: I can swim. / You must go.
contrast.diff: 中英难得一致：都用小词定强弱。差别在英语的小词有特权语法，中文的「会、必须」没有。

contrast.cn: 他会拉琴。（「会」不用管他是谁）
contrast.en: He can play.（can 从不加 s）
contrast.diff: 中文动词本来就不变；英语普通动词遇三单要加 s，唯独情态小分队免疫。

contrast.en: Can you come?（can 搬到最前面）
contrast.diff: 中文问句靠语气词；英语情态词自己搬家提问，不请 do。

contrast.cn: 不必带伞。／不准带手机。（两个词分得清清楚楚）
contrast.en: You don't have to bring an umbrella. / You mustn't bring your phone.
contrast.diff: 中文「不必／不准」两个词；英语 mustn't 只表「不准」，「不必」得绕道 don't have to。

contrast.cn: 也许会下雨。（「也许」是副词）
contrast.en: It may rain.（may 是情态动词）
contrast.diff: 中文的「也许」修饰整句；英语把这层「不确定」也交给动词前的记号。

quickJudge.mnemonic: 先选记号定强弱：must 重、should 劝、can 行、may 轻；再查特权：原形、无 s、自己搬家。
steps: 定态度：必须没商量 → must；建议 → should；能力或放行 → can；礼貌请求或「也许」 → may。
情态词后面站的必须是光秃秃的原形——没有 to、没有 s、没有 -ed。
否定？直接加 not：can't / mustn't / shouldn't——不请 don't。
提问？情态词自己搬到主语前——Can you...? May I...?
警报两响：mustn't 是「禁止」不是「不必」；过去的能力用 could。

parentScript.script: 「宝贝，英语有四个『力度记号』：must 最重，是必须；should 是应该；can 是会、可以；may 最轻，是客客气气的请求。咱们玩『看记号说话』：我用中文说一句家里的规矩，你判断它多重，再用英语说出来——『饭前必须洗手』有多重？（must）『应该早点睡』呢？（should）『可以看二十分钟动画』呢？（can）想跟我要东西时，用最轻的 May I 开头试试。我不懂英语没关系，我只检查两件事：这四个词后面的动词是不是干干净净的原形，问句是不是把它们放在了最前面。」听到 he cans、must to、Do you can，就提醒：「小分队有特权，别把它当普通动词。」
questions: 「必须、应该、可以」三种强弱，分别对应哪个英语小词？
can 和 must 后面的动词能加 s 或 to 吗？为什么不能？
mustn't 是「不必」还是「不准」？「不必」该怎么说？

sections.echo: 这支小分队为什么从不加 s？因为它们是英语里资格最老的一批动词——语言学家叫它们「过去现在动词」：它们如今的现在式，本来就是上古的过去式，天生就没有加 s 的位置。can 跟 know 是亲戚，古英语 cunnan 是「懂得」——「懂」着「懂」着就成了「会」；may 的祖先 magan 意思是「有力气」，有力气才「能」；must 干脆本来就是个过去式，用着用着定格成了「必须」。最常用的一小撮词，保住了最古老的语法特权——不加 s、自己搬家提问。又是那条暗线：越常用的词，越不规则。

memoryCard.alt: G17 记忆卡：情态动词=力度记号，must 最重（mustn't=禁止）、should 建议、can 能力与放行、may 轻声请求；小分队三特权：从不加 s、否定直接加 not、提问自己搬家；后面永远原形；警示 he cans、must to、Do you can。

questions.q: 四个力度记号里最重的是？
questions.explain: must＝必须，f 级，没商量。

questions.q: 最轻、最礼貌的请求用哪个？
questions.explain: May I...?——p 级，轻得像耳语。

questions.q: 给朋友提建议「应该……」用哪个？
questions.explain: should＝恳切的 mf 级建议。

questions.q: 表示「会游泳」这种能力用哪个？
questions.explain: can＝能力。

questions.q: 情态动词后面的动词用什么形式？
questions.explain: 记号后面永远站光秃秃的原形。

questions.q: he 后面的 can 要不要加 s？
questions.explain: 情态小分队的特权：永不变形。

questions.q: can 的否定是？
questions.explain: 直接加 not：can't（cannot）。

questions.q: mustn't 的意思是？
questions.explain: mustn't＝禁止——「不必」是 don't have to。

questions.q: 「不必做」英语怎么说？
questions.explain: don't have to＝不必；mustn't 是不准。

questions.q: should 的否定是？
questions.explain: 直接加 not——shouldn't。

questions.q: 用 can 提问时，can 站在哪里？
questions.explain: 自己搬家——Can you...?

questions.q: 情态动词提问要不要请 do 帮忙？
questions.explain: 小分队特权③：不请 do。

questions.q: You ___ wear a helmet when cycling.（必须）
questions.explain: 安全规定，最重的记号——must。

questions.q: ___ I open the window?（轻声请求）
questions.explain: 礼貌请求——May I...?

questions.q: It ___ rain later — take an umbrella.（也许）
questions.explain: may 还能表「也许」。

questions.q: 过去的能力，can 要换成？
questions.explain: 情态词自己的过去形——could。

questions.q: My baby brother ___ walk yet — he's only six months old.
questions.explain: 还不会走——能力的否定 can't。

questions.q: You ___ cross the road when the light is red.
questions.explain: 红灯禁止过马路——mustn't。

questions.q: You look tired. You ___ take a rest.
questions.explain: 关心的建议——should。

questions.q: ___ I borrow your crayons, please?
questions.explain: 带 please 的礼貌请求——May I。

questions.q: Ants are tiny, but they ___ carry things much heavier than themselves.
questions.explain: 蚂蚁的本事——能力 can。

questions.q: Students ___ bring phones into the exam room. It's the rule.
questions.explain: 考场规定，禁止——mustn't。

questions.q: — It's Sunday tomorrow. — Great, I ___ get up early!
questions.explain: 周日「不必」早起——don't have to；说 mustn't 就成了不准早起。

questions.q: You ___ brush your teeth twice a day.
questions.explain: 生活好习惯的建议——should。

questions.q: ___ you play any instrument?
questions.explain: 问能力——Can you...?

questions.q: The sign says visitors ___ take photos here.
questions.explain: 告示牌上的禁令——mustn't。

questions.q: It's late. We ___ make so much noise — Grandpa is sleeping.
questions.explain: 不该吵——shouldn't。

questions.q: — Where is Lily? — I'm not sure. She ___ be in the music room.
questions.explain: 不确定的猜测——may be。

questions.q: Everyone ___ wash hands before dinner in our home.
questions.explain: 家规，最重记号——must。

questions.q: I ___ ride a bike when I was six.
questions.explain: 过去的能力——could。

questions.q: You ___ shout in the reading room.
questions.explain: 阅览室禁止喧哗——mustn't。

questions.q: — The maths problem is too hard. — You ___ ask Miss Wang for help.
questions.explain: 给出一个可行办法——can。

questions.q: 哪句的小分队没变形？
questions.explain: can 不加 s，后面 jump 也原形。

questions.q: 哪句没多长出 to？
options: You must clean your room today.
You must to clean your room today.
You must cleaning your room today.
questions.explain: must 直接接原形。

questions.q: 哪句提问没请错帮手？
questions.explain: can 自己搬家——不请 do。

questions.q: 哪句的否定合规？
options: You shouldn't watch TV so long.
You don't should watch TV so long.
You should watch not TV so long.
questions.explain: 情态词否定直接 + not——shouldn't。

questions.q: 哪句的简答接对了？
options: — Can he cook? — Yes, he can.
— Can he cook? — Yes, he does.
— Can he cook? — Yes, he cooks can.
questions.explain: 谁提问谁接简答——can 问 can 答。

questions.q: 哪句把「不必」说对了？
options: You don't have to bring lunch — school gives us food.
You mustn't bring lunch — school gives us food.
You can't bring lunch — school gives us food.
questions.explain: 学校管饭是「不必带」——don't have to；mustn't 成了禁止。

questions.q: 哪句把「禁止」说对了？
options: You don't have to play with matches.
questions.explain: 火柴危险，禁止——mustn't。

questions.q: 哪句的过去能力说对了？
questions.explain: 过去能力用 could，后面仍原形。

questions.q: 哪句的礼貌请求合规？
options: Do I may leave the table?
questions.explain: May 自己搬家 + 原形 leave。

questions.q: 哪句写对了？（他也许在图书馆）
options: He may be in the library.
He may is in the library.
He mays be in the library.
questions.explain: may + be 原形；may 不加 s。

questions.q: 哪句写对了？（你不能在走廊跑）
options: You mustn't run in the hallway.
You must don't run in the hallway.
You mustn't running in the hallway.
questions.explain: mustn't + 原形 run。

questions.q: 哪句写对了？（我们该多喝水吗）
options: Do we should drink more water?
questions.explain: should 搬家 + 原形 drink。

questions.q: 哪句写对了？（她能背下整首诗）
options: She can say the whole poem from memory.
She can to say the whole poem from memory.
She can says the whole poem from memory.
questions.explain: can + 原形 say。

questions.q: 哪句写对了？（游客必须排队）
questions.explain: must 不变形 + 原形 wait。

questions.q: 哪句写对了？（你不该给流浪猫喂巧克力）
options: You shouldn't feed chocolate to street cats.
You shouldn't to feed chocolate to street cats.
You don't should feed chocolate to street cats.
questions.explain: shouldn't + 原形 feed。

questions.q: 哪句写对了？（——我必须今天交吗？——不必）
options: — Must I hand it in today? — No, you don't have to.
— Must I hand it in today? — No, you mustn't.
— Must I hand it in today? — No, you can't.
questions.explain: 「不必」= don't have to；mustn't 会变成「禁止上交」。

stages.name: 用一用 · 台上定强弱

questions.q: 医生对咳嗽的病人说：You ___ smoke, and you ___ drink more warm water.
questions.explain: 禁烟是禁令 mustn't；多喝热水是建议 should。

questions.q: 图书馆门口的牌子：You ___ talk loudly, but you ___ read any book you like.
questions.explain: 禁止喧哗 mustn't；随便看书是放行 can。

questions.q: — ___ I try your telescope? — Sure, but you ___ hold it with both hands.
questions.explain: 轻声请求 May I；叮嘱「必须双手拿」用 must。

questions.q: — Dad, ___ you fix my bike chain? — Sorry, I ___. Let's ask Uncle Li.
questions.explain: 问能力 Can you；做不到 I can't。

questions.q: New students ___ wear the school uniform, but they ___ buy the school bag — any bag is fine.
questions.explain: 校服是硬规定 must；书包「不必」买 don't have to。

questions.q: The ice is very thin. You ___ skate on the lake today!
questions.explain: 冰太薄，人命关天的禁令——mustn't。

questions.q: — I have a fever. — You ___ stay in bed, and you ___ go to training tonight.
questions.explain: 该卧床 should；不该去训练 shouldn't。

questions.q: Grandma is sleeping, so we ___ speak quietly. We ___ wake her up.
questions.explain: 该小声 should；不许吵醒 mustn't。

questions.q: — Look, the sky is getting dark. — It ___ rain. We ___ take the umbrella, just in case.
questions.explain: 「也许下雨」may；「最好带伞」should。

questions.q: My cousin is amazing: she ___ speak three languages, and she ___ do it when she was ten.
questions.explain: 现在的能力 can；过去就会 could already。

questions.q: — ___ we feed the ducks in the park? — Look at the sign: visitors ___ feed the birds.
questions.explain: 问「可不可以」Can we；牌子写着禁止 mustn't。

questions.q: You ___ finish the whole book tonight — the report is due next month. But you ___ start early anyway.
questions.explain: 「不必」今晚读完 don't have to；「最好」早点开始 should。

questions.q: — ___ I take one more cookie, Mum? — You ___, but only one. Dinner is soon.
questions.explain: 轻声请求 May I；妈妈放行 you can。

questions.q: Drivers ___ stop when children are crossing — it's the law, not a suggestion.
questions.explain: 法律要求，最重记号——must，比 should 重。

questions.q: — I ___ find my glasses anywhere! — They ___ be on the piano. I saw something shiny there.
questions.explain: 找不到 can't find；「也许在钢琴上」may be。

questions.q: 大考：In the pool area, you ___ run, you ___ warm up before swimming, and you ___ ask the coach anything you like.
questions.explain: 禁跑 mustn't（f）、该热身 should（mf）、随时可问 can——三档力度一次排齐。

detective.sentence: My brother cans play football very well.
detective.fixed: My brother can play football very well.
detective.clue: 情态动词从不加 s——can 的特权就是永不变形。

detective.sentence: You must to drink some water after running.
detective.fixed: You must drink some water after running.
detective.clue: must 直接接原形，不带 to——它不是 want to 那一家的。

detective.sentence: Do you can see the blackboard from here?
detective.fixed: Can you see the blackboard from here?
detective.clue: can 自己会搬家提问——再请 do 就是两个指挥抢拍子。

detective.sentence: She can plays the flute and the piano.
detective.fixed: She can play the flute and the piano.
detective.clue: can 后面站原形——plays 的 s 要摘掉。

detective.sentence: You don't should eat ice cream when you have a cold.
detective.fixed: You shouldn't eat ice cream when you have a cold.
detective.clue: 情态词的否定直接加 not——shouldn't，不请 don't。

detective.sentence: — Must we bring our own paper? — No, you mustn't. The teacher has some.（想说不必带）
detective.fixed: — Must we bring our own paper? — No, you don't have to. The teacher has some.
detective.clue: mustn't 是「禁止带」——「不必」要说 don't have to，意思差一个天地。

detective.sentence: I can climb trees when I was little.
detective.fixed: I could climb trees when I was little.
detective.clue: 过去的能力用 could——情态词也要跟着故事的调走。
